description: Source code for STM32 IPM (Inter-Processor Messaging) driver using IPCC (Inter-Processor Communication Controller) in Zephyr RTOS, including interrupt handling, channel management, and device initialization.

methods.name: stm32_ipcc_mailbox_rx_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for receiving messages via IPCC, processes received messages, disables/enables channels, and invokes callback.

methods.name: stm32_ipcc_mailbox_tx_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for transmission completion, disables transmit channels.

methods.name: stm32_ipcc_mailbox_ipm_send
methods.description: Sends a message (doorbell) on a specified channel if the channel is free.

methods.name: stm32_ipcc_mailbox_ipm_max_data_size_get
methods.description: Returns maximum data size supported (none in this case).

methods.name: stm32_ipcc_mailbox_ipm_max_id_val_get
methods.description: Returns maximum ID value based on number of channels.

methods.name: stm32_ipcc_mailbox_ipm_register_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback function for message reception.

methods.name: stm32_ipcc_mailbox_ipm_set_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables IPCC mailbox interrupts and channels.

methods.name: stm32_ipcc_mailbox_init
methods.description: Initializes the mailbox device, sets up clock, disables interrupts, and configures IRQs.

methods.name: stm32_ipcc_mailbox_config_func
methods.description: Configures IRQs for the mailbox device.
